title: Efforts to Ensure Singapore-European Union Free Trade Agreement Comes into Force
what_it_is: Efforts to Ensure Singapore-European Union Free Trade Agreement Comes into Force

sections.label: ECJ ruling on EUSFTA competence
sections.summary: The ECJ ruled most EUSFTA provisions fall under exclusive EU competence, except non-direct foreign investments and investor-state dispute settlement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Specifically, the ECJ ruled that all provisions in the EUSFTA fall under the exclusive competence of the EU with specific exceptions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: These exceptions are provisions relating to, firstly, non-direct foreign investments, such as portfolio investments; and, secondly, the regime governing dispute settlement between investors and states.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Since the release of the ECJ Opinion, the EU has been discussing internally on the modality for negotiating and ratifying FTAs, including the EUSFTA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: This includes the possibility of having the FTA cover the provisions that belong to the EU's exclusive competence, while provisions that are of shared competence are incorporated into a separate Bilateral Investment Agreement.

sections.label: Bilateral Investment Agreement ratification process
sections.summary: The shared-competence Bilateral Investment Agreement requires approval from the Council, European Parliament and 38 national and regional parliaments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: The separate Bilateral Investment Agreement, which is of "shared competence", would have to go through the process of obtaining approval at the Council, the European Parliament, as well as the 38 national and regional parliaments of all EU member states.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Singapore has conveyed to the EU that our priority remains to ensure an expeditious ratification of the EUSFTA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: We will continue to work closely with the Commission to have the FTA ratified in order for our businesses to benefit from the agreement as soon as possible.
